claim: Verify against the game's own screen or buffer as well as your own model: a second independent comparison catches faults that hooks and the first model share.

evidence.text: Level-end curtain found by the attribute model at frame 16,420, not by looking.
Whole-picture replay model caught the Layer 2 LDI carry at column 31; hook registers and RAM alone did not.
Composite check against the original's screen found the game's one-pass glitches.
Model caught a lost MMU line in a refactor at once.
Native pictures caught a selector-model mistake.
